{{Quote|Diva Shaliqua. A singer in a band.|Jabba the Hutt, introducing Magister Hego Damask to Shaliqua|<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''Diva Shaliqua''' was a half-[[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] originally in the custody of [[Ingoda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Named for the [[Diva|elite]] group of Theelin singers, Shaliqua's parents were killed while she was still a child, but she continued to serve her master until custody over her was transferred to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], Ingoda's business rival. Jabba would take her to varied public events, such as the [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At one of these gatherings, Shaliqua met [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Romeo Treblanc]], who was actually the owner of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]].

Though Treblanc suffered a great financial loss at the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Podrace]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he took a great deal of interest in the half-Theelin, seeing that she had untapped singing talent. When he had recuperated his losses in the following year, he purchased Shaliqua from Jabba, and took her back to Coruscant, where he hoped she would perform as an opera singer in his theater. Shaliqua, however, did not know of Treblanc's intent, and instead decided to rob him, before escaping his custody. Keeping a low profile, she made a living singing at varying nightclubs in Coruscant's less reputable districts.

==Biography==
{{Quote|A gift from Ingoda, in place of credits owed to me. She and Diva Funquita came as a pair, but I made Funquita a present to Gardulla in the hope of smoothing over our lingering rivalry. My first mistake. The second: introducing Shaliqua to Romeo Treblanc, who would move worlds to possess her.|Jabba the Hutt, on Diva Shaliqua|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
Diva Shaliqua was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] Theelin halfbreed who was born to a pair of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in the custody of [[Ingoda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. One of the slaves was of the rare [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which the Hutt tended to "collect". However, he forbade fraternization between slaves. Shaliqua was named "[[Diva]]" in honor of the religious order of Theelin [[Musician/Legends|singers]]. The name was also bequeathed to her in the hopes that she would live up to it, and develop great singing talents. Ingoda discovered the child and the fact that the slaves had been fraternizing, but decided to let Diva live, should she bear the fabled Theelin operatic skills. In that case, Ingoda decided that it would be financially wise to keep Shaliqua as a singer. Ingoda, however, became indebted to his rival, the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]-based [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], and was forced to sell both Shaliqua and [[Diva Funquita/Legends|Diva Funquita]] to the other Hutt.<ref name="db" />

Jabba gave Funquita away to fellow Hutt, [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]], but he kept Shaliqua for his personal band. He would take her to the [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]], where, in [[Jabba's private box|his private box]] in the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Grand Arena]], she would meet Jabba's fellow [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]], such as [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], [[Graxol Kelvyyn/Legends|Graxol Kelvyyn]], and [[Romeo Treblanc]]. Treblanc, being the owner of the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], took particular interest in Shaliqua. The half-Theelin took note of the fact that Treblanc's interests in her were not of the carnal type, but far more sophisticated.<ref name="db" /> In about [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Shaliqua traveled with Jabba, his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] and his [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] security chief [[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]], where the Hutt held a business meeting with the influential [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] industrialist [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Shaliqua later accompanied Jabba to the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] podrace of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and Romeo Treblanc suffered a huge financial loss during the event, after he bet on the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]]. The [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] racer was soundly beaten by young [[Human/Legends|Human]] competitor [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], forcing Treblanc to leave Tatooine and return to Coruscant. He promised, however, to return to Shaliqua [[Standard year/Legends|year]] later.<ref name="db" />

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Treblanc stayed true to his promise and purchased, and freed Shaliqua from Jabba, who did not recognize her true talent and had lost interest in the half-Theelin. Treblanc had recovered from his losses in the previous year, and hoped to cast Shaliqua in a small role for an upcoming musical to be played at Galaxies. He brought her back to Coruscant to study and perform at the Opera House, but mere hours after disembarking, Shaliqua fled the Coruscanti's custody, taking her emancipation datawork and some of Treblanc's minor valuables. Adopting a stage name, she worked in Coruscant's more seedy locales, singing at nightclubs and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] in Coruscant's mid-levels. It was a legitimate career, but likely a far cry from the success she would have enjoyed in Treblanc's custody.<ref name="db" />

==Personality and traits==
Growing up in a harsh environment as a slave, Shaliqua developed a highly suspicious persona, as most who took interest in her as an adult were not interested in any kind of musical talent she might possess. When she ''did'' come across someone who took interest, she continued to harbor the thought that his intentions were not strictly honorable, and fled his custody at first opportunity, despite Treblanc's generosity. She had pale-[[Color/Legends|colored]] skin and blue hair, and she wore a revealing costume during the Boonta Eve Podrace of 32 BBY.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Diva_Shaliqua_Episode_I_Snapshot.jpg|250px|thumb|Shaliqua's full costume during filming]]
The character of Diva Shaliqua, portrayed by actress [[Bianca Warren]], first appeared in [[George Lucas]]' movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], where she briefly appeared in the "Boonta Eve Podrace" sequence. She was given a name in [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], and her backstory was elaborated on by "[[Nelwyn53100|newlyn53100]]" and [[Nathan O'Keefe]] through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature, "[[What's The Story?]]." O'Keefe elaborated upon Shaliqua's biographical details, while "newlyn53100" explored the history of the Theelin species.

Information from her [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry was later used in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. In [[2012]], Shaliqua made an appearance in [[James Luceno]]'s novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]. The book stated that Shaliqua had orange-colored hair and purple beauty spots that ran down her face and neck, which conflicts with her depiction in ''The Phantom Menace'' as a plain-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] with blue hair.
